featured.name: TruckersMP's Halloween Convoy
featured.description:
### Our Halloween Convoy of 2026 has been scheduled and you're **all invited**!  

  The event takes place on the **31st October 2026** at **17:00 UTC!**  

---

   ### **Information** 
   
   We will take to the roads of ETS2 in the dead of night during the witching hour. 
   Are you brave enough to enter? Who knows what might be lurking in the shadows!  
   
   You can find all the details via our [Blog Post](link)  
   
   ### :parking: | **Parking** 
   
   > You may park at any company available in **Paris** with a **no collision zone**. 
   
   ![Convoy Route](https://cdn.truckersmp.com/assets/40c74b71-7a64-47ba-9bc4-a65bdfab5293.avif)
featured.rule:
Event Rules for Participants
* Impersonating Event Staff using the aforementioned tags is forbidden.
* Participants must follow Event Staff instructions.
* Participants must haul a trailer. (Except Event Staff)
* Triple trailer and HCT trailer configurations are prohibited. (Except Event Staff)
* Double trailer configurations are prohibited. (Except Event Staff)
* Heavy Haul configurations are prohibited. (Except Event Staff)
* Cars are prohibited except for Event Staff showing a clear tag.
* Buses are prohibited except for event staff showing a clear tag.
* Overtaking is prohibited.
* Advertising is prohibited. (Except Event Staff)
* Free roaming on the server is prohibited.
* Participants with consistent lag must remain at the back of the convoy.
* Participants must only leave the starting location when instructed to do so in an orderly (one by one) manner.  
All other TruckersMP rules apply.  

Event Rules for Event Staff
* Event Staff can block junctions and roads approaching junctions in order to direct the convoy.
* Event Staff can park out of bounds. Providing this is on the ground and not on top of buildings or other inappropriate places deemed unsuitable by TruckersMP Staff.  
All other TruckersMP rules apply.

featured.description:
Some of our ghosts went missing from the pumpkin farm so we think they are hiding in some of the trailers. 
   We need your help to find all seven different coloured ghosts around the area. 
   These ghosts only come out at night, so the pitch black sky will add an extra challenge to locating them! 
   Will you be the one to find them the quickest?
   But beware: the cheeky joker ghost loves to play tricks and jump around the play area. 
   Can you find him before he jumps to a new location?  

 You can find more information on our [Blog](https://truckersmp.com/blog/349)

   The event will begin on **1st of November 15:00 UTC** and you have until **1st of November 19:00 UTC** to find all the ghosts.

featured.name: Official ETS2 Convoy - October 2026
featured.description:
### Our Official October Convoy of 2026 has been scheduled and you're **all invited**! 👀  

> This month, we are heading to Daugavpils, traveling through the Baltic area to end in Saint Petersburg.

The event takes place on the **24th October 2026** at **17:00 UTC!**  


---


### :book: | **Information**  

The convoy duration is estimated to be around **90 minutes**, possibly a bit more if you're near the rear!    

No breaks are scheduled, but you are welcome to pull over in a safe place if you require to do so!    

You can find the departure in your time by zone following **[this](https://notime.zone/P2n_zTokGmtO6)** link.    

![Route Image](https://static.truckersmp.com/images/event/map/38163.1790793179.png)

---


### :parking: | **Parking**  

> You may park at any company available in **Daugavpils** with a **no collision zone**.   

Depending on the capacity required we may block some companies off with signs and barriers, so ensure you head to a company that is open.    

There is plenty of space, please **do not park on pavements**.  

As for the destination, the Event Team will direct you to what company to park in.  


---


> Please feel free to comment or ask questions in our Discord channel **[#official-convoy](https://discord.com/channels/307433337126125568/720400776366653490)** or on the forum post **[here](hhttps://forum.truckersmp.com/index.php?/topic/121230-official-ets2-convoy-october-2026/)**!

today.name: CONVOI ANNIVERSAIRE
today.description:
C’est le grand jour : la T.I.B.P. fête son anniversaire !
Pour célébrer cette étape importante, nous sortons nos camions les plus stylés, nos couleurs emblématiques et toute notre énergie pour un convoi exceptionnel.
Feux d’artifice, ambiance, organisation impeccable… tout est réuni pour vivre une soirée mémorable.
Merci à tous ceux qui nous accompagnent depuis le début. Aujourd’hui, on roule pour célébrer notre histoire et tout ce qui nous attend encore.![](file:///C:/Users/User/Desktop/T.I.B.P/tibp.jpg)

Chaque conducteur garde sa place pour garantir la sécurité, l’ordre et l’harmonie du groupe.
Nous roulons ensemble, dans le respect de chacun, avec calme, patience et bonne humeur — c’est notre identité, c’est notre famille.

today.name: Cancer Awareness 2026
today.description:
Welcome to Cancer awareness event!


* **Event Server Opens at 11am BST
* People arrive 11.30am BST
* route 1 starts at 12pm BST
* Route 1 ends 2pm BST
* 20 minutes break
* Route 2 Starts at 2.20pm BST
* Route 2 Ends at 4.20pm BST
* 20 minutes break
* Route 3 starts at 4.40pm BST
* Route 3 ends at 6.40pm BST
* Event server closes 9pm BST**

We are back again for another year of Cancer Awareness! [Charity Discord Server](https://discord.gg/uyAPcu9kUm)



I know cancer can be really tough to fight and it's close to people's family so I went on and decided why not do my own cancer event to raise money for cancer

This is really close to me so I would like to see as many people as we can get there and show some support!

what is cancer?

Cancer is a group of diseases involving abnormal cell growth with the potential to invade or spread to other parts of the body. These contrast with benign tumors, which do not spread With more cancer research funding, Congress can help save more lives. Every major cancer breakthrough in the past 50 years can be traced back to federally funded research. More funding for cancer research means new lifesaving treatments, new ways to prevent the disease, and more lives saved.

Cancer Awareness Campaigns get people talking about cancer, reduces the stigma of the disease, and increases support for those suffering from cancer. Putting a face to cancer can help people understand the reality of a cancer diagnosis and bring home the importance of prevention in reducing each person’s overall risk.

Together we can beat cancer.


Event: Planned for Sunday 18th October 2026!

now.name: TruckersFM11 - Festival #TFM11
now.description:
# **Welcome to TruckersFM's 11th Anniversary Festival! 🎉**
To celebrate TruckersFM turning 11 years old, we're throwing a one-of-a-kind party! Over the weekend, there will be loads to get involved with both in-game, and on-air.  
Want to come and join the celebrations? Dial in the radio to TruckersFM and come join us at our festival!

![TFM11 Festival Map](https://i.ibb.co/yFNvVcvG/tfm11-festival.jpg)

> **Server opens:** 17:00 BST  
**Festival starts:** 18:00 BST  
**Festival ends:** 23:00 BST  
**Location:** TruckersFM 11 City (located near London, UK)

---

At the festival, why not come and get involved with all of our events? There might even be prizes to be won!

## Bash the Bin
**Time:** 18:00 - 20:00 BST  
**Prize(s):** TBC  
Ever played TMP's "Knock the cone"? This is our twist on it! In front of you is a drag strip, with 3 bins lined up in a triangle at the end. The aim of the game is to bash the front bin (marked by the first of the two white lines) WITHOUT bashing the rear two bins (marked by the second of the two white lines). If you bash the rear bins (or cross the second line), you're out! The first to bash the first bin but not the second is the winner!  
![](https://i.ibb.co/RkhpLQj5/eut2-hq-6ac554ee.jpg)

## Off-road track
**Time:** 19:00 - 22:00 BST  
**Prize(s):** TBC  
Are you feeling adventurous? Why not take on the off-road track challenge! In this event, you'll be timed around our specially made off-road course, located in the TFM11 Quarry. There will be many challenges, on this course which will test the limits of your driving skills! You'll want to make a quicksave before taking part, as vehicle damage is guaranteed! How quickly can you get round the course?  
![](https://i.ibb.co/KpH3Tp6D/eut2-hq-6ac557ef.jpg)

## Race Track
**Time:** 20:00 - 23:00 BST  
**Prize(s):** TBC  
The ultimate test of speed! Bring out your fastest truck and race other players on our all new race track! Filled with exciting corners, straights, and lots of space for showing off your speed, the race track will crown the quickest drivers of the night! Be careful though, it's easy to flip a truck if you're cornering too fast!  
![](https://i.ibb.co/ZR4CpZV3/eut2-hq-6ac55888.jpg)

---

And there's so much more fun we haven't mentioned, such as the main stage where you can come and vibe with our staff & partners at TruckersMP! We can't wait to see you there, celebrating 11 Years of broadcasting!

## **[Why not also check out the #TFM11 Convoy?](https://truckersmp.com/events/35194)**

- All participants must follow the official TruckersMP rules as well as the instructions given by the convoy organizers.

- The speed limits set by the Leader must be respected.

- Voice communications must remain clear and related to the convoy.
- Insults, provocations and discriminatory remarks are prohibited.
- Only the Leader and moderation team may give traffic and convoy instructions.
- Off-topic discussions should be kept to a minimum during the journey.

upcoming.rule:
Event Rules for Participants:
The Event Staff are recognized as: **“Super | CC” “Super | ES” “Super | EA” “Super | Lead” “Super | Co-Lead” “Super | Tail” “Super | Co-Tail” “Super | Media” “Super | GM” “Super | Support”** or similar.
Free roaming on the server is prohibited.
Participants must haul a trailer.
Double trailers, Triple trailers, HCT trailers and Heavy Haul configurations are prohibited. (Except Event Staff)
Participants should park at their designated slots. If you don't have a designated slot you are required to park in the 'Public Parking' area.
Overtaking is prohibited.
Cars are prohibited except for event staff showing a clear tag.
Participants are allowed to block the parking lane and the left lane at the start and break for a smooth starting and resume. The lane between them must be kept clear for participants who wish to drive to their VTC, petrol station or to leave the convoy. According to this image: https://imgur.com/oRAwvAy.png
All other TruckersMP rules apply.

Event Rules for Event Staff:
Event Staff can block junctions and roads approaching junctions in order to direct the convoy.
Event Staff can park out of bounds. Providing this is on the ground and not on top of buildings or other inappropriate places deemed unsuitable by TruckersMP Staff.
Event Staff overtaking the convoy cannot be performed by more than 2 members at a time.
Event Staff can drive the incorrect way where roads have a central reservation barrier ONLY. In accordance with the rule above.
All other TruckersMP rules apply.
